text:
Type: dark grey industrial floor lamp
Use: reading or directed light beside a sofa or an armchair; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: matte powder-coated steel shade, pole and round base, white inner shade, black cord with foot switch
Colors: dark charcoal grey, white inside
Shape: large tilting bell shade on a straight thin pole, heavy round base, tall with a bold head, medium visual weight
Feel: strong, urban, practical, moody
Goes with: leather or grey sofas, concrete, dark wood, brick; industrial lofts and modern living rooms

product.name: HEKTAR
product.description: The oversized lamp head gives both a good concentrated light for reading and good general light for smaller areas.
